narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>For your own plant, record all seven counts before you calculate anything.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then add them and divide by seven to get flowers per day.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your plant will give its own answer, so compare it with a friend's plant.
